sentences: Watch for the milder stuff too, like coming back from trip after trip confused or spaced out.
When it's bad, or it's putting you in danger, see a doctor or a therapist right away.
Don't wait if it keeps happening when you're sober, either.
And don't just stop a prescribed medicine because you think it's part of the problem.
Coming off some things too fast can be dangerous, alcohol too, once your body depends on it.
